mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, which forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%), a further decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% and declines, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeds 2.5% on a year-over-year basis, it signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime (characterized by low unemployment and high job growth), a sharp acceleration in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals potential overheating, triggering equity market corrections and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when the regime condition is met and PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate declines while the unemployment rate rises, it signals a monetary policy response to a deteriorating labor market, which forecasts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to conflicting economic signals.
regime_hint: monetary easing amid labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises for 3 consecutive months, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is negative over 3-year rolling windows.
